answer: Each identity must bind one verified payroll account: an employer signs a payroll record, one identity per account, backed by a 40 POA bond locked 90 days, slashed if the same account backs a second identity. Honest pay reaches one hive, sweet as nectar, while a fake cannot split one salary across many mouths. Each extra fake needs another employer, so 100 fakes demand 100 payrolls and 4,000 POA locked, and bribing employers grows dearer like saffron as demand rises. Payroll hashes and signatures sit on-chain, so any verifier replays them and cracks each walnut of a claim before payout.
